objects.name: hazard_event
objects.description: One way produce could reach a buyer unsafe, drawn as a bow-tie: a batch contaminated, spoiled in transit or mislabelled.

indexes.name: batch_scope
indexes.description: Finds the hazards that apply to one stage of a batch's life, such as field, store or transport.

objects.name: route
objects.description: One way a hazard gets into a batch, such as dirty irrigation water or an unwashed crate, or one way its harm spreads once it has, such as a shared load or a late recall.

objects.name: control_measure
objects.description: One practice a farm or supplier runs to keep produce safe: washing, cold storage, crate cleaning, a supplier checklist, a recall procedure.

objects.name: control_point
objects.description: One practice claimed to stand on one route, such as cold storage on the spoilage route at the collection point and not yet on the route from farm to depot.

objects.name: check
objects.description: One inspection, temperature log, lab result or spot check about one control point.

objects.name: rating
objects.description: One rating of how likely an unsafe batch is and how serious the harm would be, before and after the practices as they are really followed.

objects.name: corrective_action
objects.description: One piece of work to fix a weak control point, with the person responsible and the date it is due.
